hero.title: A's Athletics
hero.subtitle: Cheer, dance, Ninja Warrior training, and birthday parties in Tuscaloosa & Northport — building skills, confidence, and champions.

about.heading: Building Skills. Building Confidence. Building Champions.
about.body: At A's Athletics, our mission is to empower children, teens, and adults through movement, athletics, discipline, and personal growth. We provide a positive, inclusive environment where athletes of all ages can develop their skills, build confidence, strengthen their bodies, and discover their potential. Through competitive cheer, tumbling, Ninja Warrior training, and dance, we aim to develop more than great athletes — we build confidence, character, discipline, resilience, and a commitment to excellence, inspiring every athlete to believe in themselves, work hard, have fun, and grow stronger both inside and out.

programs.name: All-Star Teams
programs.description: Levels 1–3, tryouts each spring. Full competition season with regional and national events.

programs.name: Tumbling Classes
programs.description: Tiny Tots through advanced tumbling instruction, open to athletes outside our competitive teams.

programs.name: Private Coaching
programs.description: One-on-one sessions for skill-specific goals, including stunts, jumps, tumbling, and motion technique.

programs.name: Dance
programs.description: Technique-based classes in jazz, hip-hop, and pom styles for all ages and skill levels.

programs.name: Ninja Warrior Training
programs.description: Obstacle-course training built for strength, agility, speed, and flexibility — inspired by American Ninja Warrior.

programs.name: Birthday Parties
programs.description: Custom party themes — cheer, dance, ninja warrior, sports, orbi gel, or blacklight — plus add-ons like a rock climbing wall, zip line, arcade games, cotton candy, snow cones, a popcorn machine, hot dog rollers, and bounce houses.
